The package itself now carries the scope: ip_manifest.json assumptions + README.txt SCOPE/ASSUMPTIONS state OOC 5 ns only, 0.000 ns input-delay model, HD.CLK_SRC unset, keep the 1,192 DONT_TOUCH cells, input setup budget +0.135 ns (real upstream max delay above it would fail), and platform/bit/HWH/board not_run.

ooc.detail: 5ns routed OOC on the hold-fix cut (build/spikformer/nlp_48h_20261029_1915/final/nlp_real_5stage_r4_holdfix/ooc_run_20261030_120804): setup WNS +0.135 ns / TNS 0 / 0 failing; hold WHS +0.023 ns / THS 0 / 0 failing; pulse width 0 failing; unrouted nets 0; no timing exceptions, 5.000 ns clock only. Method: read-only DCP classification of the r2 failing cut proved all 32,852 failing hold endpoints start at input ports (i_w_data 29,414 / i_tab_data 3,054 / i_tok_id 384; zero internal startpoints), i.e. the OOC 0-input-delay port->first-register model; post-route phys_opt -hold_fix had repaired only 50 of 4,821 candidate nets. Fix: DONT_TOUCH LUT1 input hold-margin cells in the generated target adapter (tools/backends/spikformer/codegen.py): 8 stages on each of 149 sampled input bits including s_rst (1,192 LUT1 cells), pure combinational delay, no state/protocol/clock change and no timing exception. The generated spikformer.xdc is byte-identical to the failing cut (sha256 9fc1c2676a29bbab1ee6277b9bb60a882c5e868396ab03ee36aa1f8a2eb10842; no false path/multicycle, no downclock); the 18 frozen RTL hashes are unchanged; functional replays re-run 2026-10-30 on the same frozen RTL are mismatch=0. Stage calibration: 16-stage synth probe rejected (setup), 10-stage routed cut passed with WHS +0.001 ns and was superseded by this 8-stage cut. Remaining OOC-model limits stay labelled unverified: HD.CLK_SRC unset (no top-level clock-buffer fact), 0.000 ns input-delay assumption, platform/bit/HWH/board not_run. The binding hold item is now an internal FF->FF path (+0.023 ns, thin; same path class as in the failing cut, where it had no negative slack, masked by the -0.080 ns input paths; not re-measured on the r2 DCP) and must be re-checked under a real clock tree. The routed WNS binding path is the inserted hold-margin chain itself (from-port setup slack +0.135 ns, below the ~0.3 ns engineering-target suggestion); the 0.000 ns input-delay model is optimistic, so a real upstream max input delay >0.135 ns would violate it and this package is not integration-ready without re-timing / a shorter chain or integrated-top register slice plus real interface min/max re-constraint. async_default group WHS 0.750 ns.
